## AVIM Therapy and the Medtronic–Orchestra BioMed Collaboration at HRX Live 2026


Watch the sponsored roundtable from HRX Live 2026, moderated by Vivek Reddy, MD, and featuring Robert C. Kowal, MD, PhD, Vice President and General Manager of Cardiac Pacing Therapies at Medtronic, Andrea Russo, MD, Charles Love, MD, and Orchestra BioMed Chairman and CEO David Hochman.


The panel explores AVIM Therapy’s potential to treat uncontrolled hypertension in pacemaker-indicated patients, reviewing its mechanism of action, clinical evidence and the BACKBEAT Global Pivotal Trial, which recently surpassed enrollment completion. The discussion also highlights how our strategic collaboration with Medtronic is advancing development and examines potential future applications in hypertensive heart disease.


*Recorded September 19, 2026.*
